summary: Added meterbill/money.py (exact-arithmetic round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed), routed all rounding/formatting through it, removed the decimal context line, added tests/test_money.py. Preserved quirk: batch worker threads used the default HALF_EVEN context, so band charges and effective prices in batch now explicitly use HALF_EVEN (keyword-only method params on charge_bands, bill.compute, report.effective_price/bill_record/batch_line) while other paths use HALF_UP; VAT label/tariff listing round half up; also kept 'whole' payable never printing -0. Differential fuzzing against the original showed identical CLI output.
